data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 1088 (merged as 9c44a4160 after server-side rebase; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Implementation exactly per the passed plan: prompts.py gains SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE (with the Pass-1 exhaustiveness directive bullet) + shared_plan_prefix(plan); passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE deleted and _resolve_system made plan-first for the finder; both verifier templates now lead with {{shared_prefix}} and lost {{plan}} + the volatile marker (finding listing stays user-turn); plan_review_verify_inputs emits shared_prefix (plan output dropped, schema updated, both plan-review.yaml verify with: blocks rewired); runs.py untouched (generic string with:-merge carries the variable); Pass-1 warm gate now measures the actual prefix (pass1._prefix_tokens); plan-review-verifier removed from RELOCATED_PROMPTS; CONTRIBUTING.md single-source reference + invariants updated. Tests: new tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py (15 tests: byte-identical prefix across Pass-1 + both verifier stable segments, >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS floor, directive in every Pass-1 entry point, listing never in system, warm-gate boundary, yaml/schema wiring) + 5 existing test files updated per the plan's consumer enumeration. Gates: make lint, make typecheck, tests/unit/workflow (513) and full tests/unit (6124 passed, 19 skipped) all green. Plan review history: 5 pre-repair BLOCK rounds, then 3 repair rounds (BLOCK, BLOCK, PASS+signed).
